name: Rumbo
tagline: Plan a trip from one sentence.
summary: One ranked travel feed, for you on the web and for your AI agents over MCP.

highlights.label: PLANNER
highlights.title: One sentence becomes a trip
highlights.text: English, Spanish or Russian in; ranked places with live fares out.

highlights.label: FARES
highlights.title: Prices from licensed sources
highlights.text: Every price shows its source and link. The AI never writes a number.

highlights.label: FEED
highlights.title: One ranked travel feed
highlights.text: Scored on deal, fit, taste, urgency and novelty, with reasons shown.

highlights.label: WATCHES
highlights.title: Watch routes, stays, activities
highlights.text: An hourly collector checks each watch within its daily caps.

highlights.label: MCP
highlights.title: 13 tools for your agents
highlights.text: Claude, Codex, ChatGPT and Grok connect over MCP or JSON.

highlights.label: SAFE
highlights.title: Agents propose, you decide
highlights.text: No tool books, pays or deletes. One owner key guards it all.

steps.title: Say where
steps.text: One sentence or a short form.

steps.title: Follow the feed
steps.text: Watches collect, you like or hide.
